DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの展望エリアをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aling observation area po ang gusto?

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内に三百五十とあるので、エレベーターの三百五十階を探しています。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 高さ数字を停止階と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.translation: May 350 po sa guide kaya hinahanap ko ang ika-350 na palapag sa elevator.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na floor stop ang inakalang height number. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その数字は高さの案内です。停止階の番号ではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Taas ang numero, hindi stopping floor.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 階数だと思っていました。入場券にあるエリア名で乗る場所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券のエリア名で乗場確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po floor. Pakitiyak ang sakayan ayon sa area name sa ticket.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng boarding point ayon sa ticket area. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券のエリアと、この乗場を照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itugma ang ticket area at sakayang ito.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 券はこちらです。高さが近い表示の別施設へ行くのでなく、施設名も合わせます。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別施設と混同せず券の施設名も照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ito po ang ticket. Hindi ako pupunta sa ibang may kahawig na height; pati facility name itutugma.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag mapaghalo ang ibang facility at itugma ang ticket name. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが対象の乗場です。追加の展望エリアは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ito ang sakop na sakayan. Hiwalay ang additional observation area.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の券で全部の高さまで行けるとは考えません。今日は対象エリアだけにします。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加エリアを含むと決めず現券の範囲を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po iisiping lahat ng taas ay kasama. Sa sakop lang ako ngayon.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag ipalagay na may dagdag na area at piliin ang saklaw ng ticket. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰る時の乗場も、上で案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tingnan din sa itaas ang pabalik na sakayan.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。高さと停止階を混ぜず、券の施設とエリアで往復の乗場を確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 高さと階を分け帰りの案内も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Hiwalay ang height at floor, at facility at area ng ticket ang batayan ng balikan.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang height at floor at tingnan pati ang pabalik. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この乗場の案内に従ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sundin ang gabay ng sakayang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 名前を入れる前に位置を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tiyakin ang puwesto bago lagyan ng pangalan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今持っている向きで下に書けばよいですか。完成時もこの向きだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作業時の向きで名前を入れる位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa ibaba po ba ayon sa hawak ko ngayon? Akala ko ganito rin sa tapos.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang name position ayon sa direksiyon habang gumagawa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 完成時の上下は見本で確認します。作業中の持ち方と同じとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa sample ang taas at baba ng tapos. Hindi laging pareho sa hawak habang gumagawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上下を確認せず印を付けそうでした。まだ付けていないので、完成時の上を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未記入を伝え完成時の上下を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mamarkahan ko po sana nang hindi tumitingin. Wala pa, kaya pakituro ang taas sa tapos.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing wala pang sulat at tiyakin ang final orientation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが上です。名前を入れる面も別に案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang taas. Hiwalay ding ituturo ang face para sa pangalan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 正面に大きく入れるつもりでした。裏面に入れる指定なら、文字の大きさも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記名面と文字サイズの指定を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Malaki sa harap po sana. Kung likod ang takda, pakisabi rin ang letter size.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang name face at letter size. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この範囲へ入れます。まず練習板で配置を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa loob ng saklaw na ito. Ipakita muna ang layout sa practice board.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本番の面へ先に彫らず、練習板へ名前の向きと大きさを示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 練習板で向きと配置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi po muna uukitin ang tunay; sa practice ang direksiyon at laki ng pangalan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita sa practice board ang orientation at layout. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配置は確認できました。実物への作業は、道具の説明後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Malinaw ang layout. Pagkatapos ng tool explanation ang aktuwal.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では作品の上下と裏面の位置を言い返して確認し、道具の説明を受けてから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上下と面を復唱し道具説明後に始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Uulitin ko po ang taas, baba at likod para matiyak, saka magsisimula matapos ang tool guide.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ulitin ang orientation at face at magsimula matapos tool guide. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で進めましょう。本番の材料はまだ置いておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ganiyan ang hakbang. Iwan muna ang tunay na materyal.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会場の移動についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tanong po sa paglipat sa venue?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 後ろから音が聞こえるので、列を戻ってそちらへ行こうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音の方向へ列を戻る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: May tunog sa likod kaya babalik sana sa pila patungo roon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang planong bumalik sa pila ayon sa tunog. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 音だけで進路を決めず、会場の案内に従ってください。列を逆へ進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi tunog lang ang direksiyon; sundin ang venue guide. Huwag sumalungat sa pila.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ戻っていません。音の方向と案内経路が違って見えたので、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未逆行と伝え案内経路の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa po bumabalik. Parang iba ang tunog at ruta kaya pakitiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa sumalungat at humiling ng route check. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の通行経路はこちらです。同行者はご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang route ngayon. Kasama ang kaibigan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同行者は先へ進んでいます。自分だけ逆へ戻らず、まず同じ案内経路で動くと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者と同じ指定方向で動くと連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nauna po siya. Hindi ako babalik nang sarili; sasabihin kong sa parehong guide route muna.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaalam ang pagsunod sa parehong direksiyon ng kasama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡は流れを妨げない場所で行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa hindi nakahahadlang sa agos makipag-ugnayan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 係の案内する場所で伝えます。音が近い場所が空いているとも思い込まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行を妨げず連絡し空き状況を音で推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa ituturong puwesto po. Hindi ko rin iisiping bakante dahil malapit ang tunog.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Kumontak nang hindi nakaharang at huwag tunog ang hula sa bakante. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見物場所は現地の誘導で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa lokal na paggabay ang viewing spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。音を頼りに列を横切らず、同行者へ現在地を知らせて誘導どおり進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地を共有し誘導に従って進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hindi tatawid sa pila sa tunog; ipapaalam ang lokasyon at susundin ang guide.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibahagi ang lugar at sumunod sa gabay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの方向へお進みください。必要な時は近くの係へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito ang direksiyon. Magtanong sa malapit na staff kung kailangan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ボール用の袋をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Bag po ba ng bola ang hinahanap?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見本が小さいので、この袋に入ると思いました。使う時もこの大きさですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未膨張の見本寸法で袋を選んだと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Maliit po ang sample kaya akala ko kasya sa bag na ito. Ganito rin kalaki kapag ginagamit, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing pinili ang bag ayon sa uninflated sample. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その見本は空気を入れていません。使用時の寸法を表示で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Walang hangin ang sample. Tingnan ang in-use dimensions sa label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: しぼんだ状態を使う大きさと考えていました。空気を入れた時のサイズを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 膨張後のサイズ確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po deflated ang ginagamit na laki. Pakisabi ang inflated size.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng size kapag may hangin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品の表示はこちらです。お持ちのボールと同じ製品ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang label. Pareho ba sa bola ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家の物は別です。見本の数字をそのまま使わず、家の製品表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家の別製品の表示を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Iba po sa bahay. Hindi ko basta gagamitin ang sample number; titingnan ang sarili naming label.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing titingnan ang ibang produkto sa bahay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の対応サイズも控えておけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaaring itala rin ang bag-compatible size.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方の表示を比べます。無理に押し込んだり、収納のためだけに自己判断で空気を抜いたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋とボールの条件を比べ無理な収納を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ihahambing po ang dalawa. Hindi ko ipipilit o sariling aalisan ng hangin para lang magkasya.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihambing ang bag at ball conditions at iwasan ang sapilitang storage. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は袋の購入を待ちますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。家のボールの使用状態と寸法を確認し、この袋の条件に合うか分かってから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅寸法確認まで袋購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. In-use state at sukat ng sa bahay muna bago bumili kung tugma.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban ang bag hanggang matiyak ang sariling sukat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では対応サイズを控えてご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Itala ang supported size at pag-isipan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品の受取り時刻を確認したいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tiyakin po ang artwork pickup time?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予定表では窯が空いています。今開けて作品を取り出してよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予定表の空きから窯を開けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Bakante po ang kiln sa schedule. Akala ko puwedeng buksan at kunin ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung puwedeng buksan sa bakanteng schedule. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約表の空きと、窯の状態は別です。担当の確認前に開けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang booking slot at kiln state. Huwag buksan bago staff check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。空き枠が安全な取出しの許可だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触と空き枠の誤解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko pa po hinawakan. Akala ko safe removal permission ang bakante.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi nahawakan at ipaliwanag ang empty-slot misunderstanding. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 温度や工程は担当が確認します。どの作品のことですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang titingin sa temperature at steps. Aling artwork?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この受付番号の作品です。隣の窯の作品もまとめて取るつもりにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作品番号を示し別窯の物を含めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa reception number na ito po. Hindi ko isasama ang sa katabing kiln.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang artwork number at huwag isama ang ibang kiln. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その番号で確認します。受取り予定は人に伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titingnan sa numero. May nasabihan ng pickup plan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日渡すと友人へ言いましたが、まだ確定していません。確認中と訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人への未確定受渡し連絡を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sinabi ko po sa kaibigan na ibibigay ngayon pero hindi pa pinal. Itatama kong sinusuri pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itama ang hindi pa tiyak na pag-abot sa kaibigan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が取り出しと受渡しの予定を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Staff ang magtuturo ng removal at handover plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。窯へ触れず、該当番号の受渡しが確認できてから友人へ改めて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状態と受渡し確認まで窯に触れず待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Hindi hahawakan ang kiln; tatawag muli kapag tiyak na ang handover ng numerong iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag hawakan at maghintay ng kiln status at handover check. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その作品の工程を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Itatanong ang proseso ng likhang iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの野菜をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 赤い袋は甘い種類だと思い、そちらを選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋色を味や品種の表示と思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Akala ko po matamis na uri ang pulang bag kaya pinili ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang lasa o uri ang bag color. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の色だけでは種類は判断できません。品名と表示を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi kulay lang ang variety. Tingnan ang pangalan at label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 色を味の区分だと思っていました。二つの品名を確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二袋の品名照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po taste category ang kulay. Pakitugma ang dalawang product names.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hilinging itugma ang pangalan ng dalawang bag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材では同じ品名です。袋の中の本数は違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa materyal na ito, pareho ang pangalan. Magkaiba ang bilang sa loob.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 味の違いではなく本数も見て選びます。今日は二人で使うので、多い方を必ず選ぶ必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 味区分を訂正し本数と用途で選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi lasa kundi bilang din po ang pagpipilian. Para sa dalawa ngayon, hindi kailangang laging mas marami.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itama ang taste category at pumili ayon sa bilang at gamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使う量や保管の予定に合わせてご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Isaalang-alang ang daming gagamitin at storage.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一度で使う予定です。少ない袋の内容を見て、傷の状態も確認してから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一回使用に合わせ少量袋の状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Isang gamit lang po. Titingnan ang maliit pati damage bago pumili.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tingnan ang kaunting bag para sa isang gamit at ang kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この袋の表示と中身をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tingnan ang label at laman nito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 少ない方にします。袋色を味の保証として家族に伝えず、表示を確認した品として持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少量を選び色で味を保証しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Mas kaunti po. Hindi ko ipapangakong lasa sa pamilya ayon sa kulay; natiyak na label ang iuuwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliin ang kaunti at huwag garantiya ng lasa ang kulay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その袋をお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 到着予定についてご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕食が六時とあるので、六時までに着けば手続きも食事も間に合うと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕食時刻までに到着すればよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Alas-sais po ang dinner kaya akala ko kung bago iyon, aabot sa proseso at pagkain.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung sapat dumating bago dinner time. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 夕食の開始とチェックインの案内は別です。ご到着の見込みを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang dinner start at check-in instructions. Anong expected arrival?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六時ちょうどになりそうです。食事時刻を到着期限と同じに読んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見込み時刻と誤読を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mukhang eksaktong alas-sais. Naitulad ko po ang dinner time at arrival deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang estimate at maling pagbasa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が受付と食事の状況を確認します。まだ移動中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang titingin sa reception at meal. Bumabyahe pa?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。無理に急いで確定時刻を約束せず、今の交通状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動中の交通状況を伝え無理な時刻約束をしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Hindi ko pipiliting magmadali at mangako ng tiyak; sasabihin ang traffic ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kasalukuyang traffic at huwag mangako ng pilit na oras. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 夕食の変更ができるかも担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itatanong rin kung mababago ang dinner.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらから食事を遅らせられると決めず、可能な対応と条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食事延期の可否と条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po iisiping basta maipapaliban; pakisabi ang kaya at kondisyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang dinner-delay possibility at kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後にご案内します。予約名を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sasabihin matapos tingnan. Ano ang reservation name?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約名はこちらです。到着見込みと食事の扱いを確認してから同行者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約名で到着食事の対応を確認し同行者へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ito po. Arrival estimate at meal arrangement muna bago ipaalam sa kasama.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin gamit ang pangalan ang arrival at dinner at ipaalam sa kasama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その予約で担当が確認します。食事時刻だけで到着の扱いを決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Staff ang titingin. Huwag dinner time lang ang basis ng arrival rules.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 割合の欄についてのご相談ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族と半分ずつ払うので、住宅の持分も半分と書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払割合を持分欄へ記入したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hati po kami ng pamilya sa bayad kaya kalahati rin ang house ownership na naisulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang payment ratio sa ownership field. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払いの話と登記などの情報は分けて確認します。資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang payment at registration information. May dokumento?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持分の資料があります。自分の話した支払割合をそのまま書くのでなく、資料を見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持分の資料で確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: May ownership document po. Hindi lang sinabi kong payment ratio ang isusulat; pakitingnan ang dokumento.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng ownership document check. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。実際の支払い記録も別にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang titingin. May hiwalay na actual payment records?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。資料の数字と違う所があるので、どちらかを消して合わせず両方示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実払記録と資料の相違を消さず示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mayroon po. Iba ang numero kaya hindi buburahin ang isa para itugma; pareho ipapakita.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang actual payment at document difference nang hindi binubura. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象となる申告と、必要な確認を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff ang magtuturo ng filing target at kailangang check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 半分と書いた用紙も残します。自己判断で割合だけ直して提出しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誤記用紙を残し自己訂正だけで提出しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itatabi ko rin po ang nasulatang kalahati. Hindi ratio lang ang babaguhin at isusumite nang sarili.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itabi ang maling form at huwag isumite sa sariling ratio correction lang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家族の資料を使う場合も、必要な範囲を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kung gamit ang family document, tiyakin rin ang necessary scope.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の持分資料と支払い記録を分けて見せ、対象と訂正方法を確認してから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象と訂正方法を二資料で担当に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Hiwalay ang sarili kong ownership at payment record; scope at correction muna bago magpatuloy.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gamit ang dalawang materyal, tiyakin ang scope at correction. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当へご案内します。二つの割合を分けて説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Igagabay sa staff. Hiwalay ipaliwanag ang dalawang ratio.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの御朱印帳を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Maaari pong tingnan ang dala ninyong stamp book?

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この空白にお願いしたいです。隣のページの印が少し写っていますが、空いています。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 裏写りのある空白ページへの記入希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.translation: Dito po sa blangko. May kaunting kopya ng kabilang page stamp pero bakante.
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng pagsulat sa blank page na may bleed-through. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ページの状態と受付できる方法を担当が確認します。こちらへ記入位置を指示する前にお見せください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Staff ang titingin sa page at puwedeng paraan. Ipakita muna bago ituro ang sulatan.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 裏写りのあるページでもそのまま書けると決めつけていました。帳面を見ていただきます。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空白だけで記入可能と判断せず帳面を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po puwede kahit may bleed-through. Pakitingnan ang book.
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Huwag magpasya sa blank lang at ipakita ang aklat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この見開きは折り目にも汚れがあります。別の方法をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-05.translation: May dumi rin sa fold ng spread. Gusto po ng ibang paraan?

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帳面を無理に広げて押さえることはしたくありません。別紙で受けられるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帳面を押し広げず別紙の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ayokong piliting ibuka at diinan. Maaari bang hiwalay na papel?
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag piliting buksan at itanong ang hiwalay na papel. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別紙の扱いは当日の案内で確認します。受け取った後の貼り付けは、ご自身で検討してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa guide ngayon titiyakin ang separate sheet. Kayo ang mag-isip sa pagdikit pagkatapos.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付で貼ってもらうことまで頼まず、まず別紙の可否を確認します。帳面は自分でしまってよいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貼付依頼は含めず帳面をしまえるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po isasama ang pagdikit sa request; separate-sheet availability muna. Maaari ko nang itabi ang book?
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag humiling ng pagdikit at tiyakin ang pagtatabi ng book. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。別紙での受付方法を担当が説明しますので、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Staff ang magpapaliwanag ng separate-sheet reception; maghintay.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帳面をしまいました。説明を聞き、別紙でお願いするか決めてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別紙の説明後に申込方法を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naitabi ko na po. Pakikinggan at magpapasya sa hiwalay na papel bago mag-apply.
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasya ng application matapos ang sheet explanation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。空白があることだけで記入可能とはせず、方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Hindi blank lang ang permission; tiyakin ang paraan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 着付けで分かりにくいところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: May hindi po malinaw sa pagdamit?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真では右側が上に見えます。今、教えていただいた重ね方は逆ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真と説明の左右が逆に見えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa photo po, kanan ang nasa ibabaw. Hindi po ba baligtad ang itinuro?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing baligtad ang kanan at kaliwa sa photo at paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その写真は鏡越しに撮ったものかもしれません。写真の左右だけで決めず、ご自身の衿で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaaring sa salamin ang photo. Huwag photo side lang; tingnan sa sariling kuwelyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鏡の映り方で混乱していました。自分の左の衿がどちらか、手で指して確認してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の左の衿を身体で確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nalito po sa mirror. Maaari kong ituro sa kamay ang sarili kong kaliwang kuwelyo para matiyak?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng pagtiyak sa sariling kaliwang collar gamit ang katawan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。こちらがご自身の左です。左の衿を上に重ねる説明を、もう一度示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo, ito ang inyong kaliwa. Ipapakita muli ang left collar sa ibabaw.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。衿を重ねたまま帯を締める前に、形を見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帯の前に衿の重なりを見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sige po. Pakitingnan ang porma habang magkapatong bago higpitan ang obi.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipasuri ang collar overlap bago obi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認します。強く引かず、今の状態で少し楽にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titingnan. Huwag hilahin nang malakas at luwagan nang kaunti sa ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 苦しくない位置に緩めました。写真の見た目に合わせて、もう一度逆にしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 苦しくないよう緩め鏡の左右で逆転させないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Niluwagan ko po sa hindi masikip. Hindi ko babaligtarin uli para itugma sa photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Luwagan upang hindi mahirapan at huwag baligtarin ayon sa mirror. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この状態で試着を続けられます。ご自身で着る時の説明も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Maipagpapatuloy ang fitting. Kailangan rin ang sariling pagdamit guide?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。鏡の左右ではなく自分の左の衿を基準にした説明をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 身体基準の着付け説明をメモしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Gusto kong itala ayon sa kaliwa ko, hindi mirror sides.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Humiling ng tala ng dressing guide ayon sa katawan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その言葉で手順を書きましょう。帯の扱いも続けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Isulat natin sa salitang iyan. Ipagpapatuloy rin ang obi guide.
